title: Flagler College Radio Weekly 200 and Adds – The Flagler College Gargoyle
text:
Flagler College Radio Weekly 200 and Adds – The Flagler College Gargoyle 

 July 8, 2013 

 Each week we’ll bring you new songs we’re playing on WFCF, Flagler College Radio, along with our Top 30 playlist that we submit to the College Music Journal (CMJ). Reporting to CMJ allows us to keep playing the newest artists, so check back each week to see who we are adding!

 Flagler College Radio  is a 10,000 watt non-commercial educational radio station broadcasting from the heart of the nation’s oldest city. WFCF boasts a variety programming format featuring many genres of music, as well as collegiate sports coverage, community spotlights and a radio theater program. You can listen to WFCF, Flagler College radio at 88.5 on the FM dial, or download the iHeartRadio app on your smartphone or tablet, and take it with you everywhere you go. For more information about WFCF, you can visit their website or find them on Facebook .
